name: komashi
description: Manage Komashi business operations, customers, subscriptions, invoices and usage without checkout or plan changes.

interface.longDescription: Manage Komashi business operations from ChatGPT: select an account-linked provider, review services and catalogue settings, find customers and contacts, inspect existing subscriptions and invoices, check or confirm usage updates, and administer supported subscription lifecycle settings. OAuth sign-in is required and access is limited to providers linked to your account. This OpenAI integration does not create subscriptions, return checkout or payment links, or initiate subscription plan upgrades or downgrades.
defaultPrompt: Show my services and active subscriptions in Komashi.
Check usage for my Komashi subscription.
Help me prepare a new service in Komashi.

positive.description: Discover account-linked businesses and select the dedicated synthetic Review Business workspace (subdomain openai-review). No production customer data or external payment provider is needed.
positive.prompt: Show my Komashi businesses. Then use Review Business for this session.
positive.expected_behavior: List only account-linked providers; resolve Review Business from returned IDs and select it. Ask for clarification if the name is ambiguous; never select an unrelated provider.

positive.description: Read the service catalogue of the selected Review Business workspace. Fixtures: Review Service, Review Plan and its monthly billing period. Resolve all IDs from tool results.
positive.prompt: Show the existing services of Review Business and the plans and billing periods of Review Service.
positive.expected_behavior: List Review Service, resolve its service_id and list Review Plan. Resolve that plan_id and use both service_id and plan_id to list its monthly period (period_length 1). Summarize returned values only; do not invent prices or change records.

positive.description: Inspect the existing ACTIVE demo subscription in the selected Review Business workspace. Fixture external_reference: Review Subscription. If it is not ACTIVE, report the unexpected fixture state and do not claim this positive test passed.
positive.prompt: Show up to 10 active subscriptions of Review Service and the details of the subscription with external reference Review Subscription.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve service_id; query list-subscriptions-tool with status ACTIVE and per_page 10. Find the returned record whose external_reference is Review Subscription, then get its details. Show status ACTIVE, Review Plan, monthly period, quantity 1, and quota 10 credits. Only selected-provider records may be returned.

positive.description: Confirm an absolute usage update on the ACTIVE synthetic Review Subscription in Review Business. Quota is 10 credits, initial usage 0. Rerun the demo seeder before recording a fresh baseline; repeat execution with usage 5 must remain 5, not become 10.
positive.prompt: Set the total usage of the subscription with external reference Review Subscription to exactly 5; I confirm this update. Then tell me how much usage remains.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected provider's subscription_id from returned records. Call sync-usage-tool with absolute usage 5, then check-usage-tool. Report usage 5, limit 10 and remaining 5 credits. Repeating the same confirmed sync keeps usage 5. If the API refuses the update, report the failure accurately; do not claim success.

positive.description: Existing invoice lookup. Dedicated review account with Review Business selected, one Review Customer and a synthetic invoice. Resolve the actual customer ID from returned records.
positive.prompt: Show up to 10 existing invoices for Review Customer.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Review Customer's customer_id, then list-invoices-tool with that ID and per_page 10. Show the synthetic invoice DEMO-REVIEW-001, total 10 EUR. Do not claim that the sample invoice proves a real card transaction, invent a download link, or generate a checkout/payment link.

negative.description: Refunds are unsupported by this MCP. State that the refund cannot be performed; do not claim a refund, initiate cancellation instead, or create a transactional link. No mutation tool call should be made.
negative.prompt: Refund the last payment of Review Customer to their card.

negative.description: This MCP can read existing discount templates but cannot create coupon codes. Explain that SUMMER20 cannot be created here. Do not create a customer, service or subscription as a substitute; no mutation tool call should be made.
negative.prompt: Create a new 20 percent coupon code SUMMER20.

negative.description: The OpenAI endpoint cannot initiate upgrades/downgrades or generate checkout/payment links. Explain this immediately, without promising an upgrade flow. Do not call a mutation tool, generate a customer magic-login URL, or use setup/portal links as a workaround. The refusal must follow endpoint capabilities, not missing demo permissions or the absence of another plan.
negative.prompt: Upgrade Review Subscription and send me a checkout link to pay the difference.

review.commerce_description: This OpenAI endpoint does not create subscriptions, generate payment/checkout links or initiate plan changes. Komashi outside this integration connects providers to external payment providers; Komashi does not hold customer funds. Existing customer and subscription administration, catalogue data and setup continuation links remain available and require policy review.

publication.release_notes: OpenAI-specific endpoint with 44 tools. Clear names and titles for saving business/service setup details; existing subscription, usage and invoice review cases clarified. Subscription creation, payment-link creation and plan changes remain excluded.
